Season 4 episode guideEPISODE JOURNAL / THE GUIDE

Season episode or original episode?

Both numbers refer to the same subtitled broadcast.

Season 4 Episode 4 is original Turkish Episode 87. Season 4 Episode 5 is original Episode 88. The season count restarts at one, while the Turkish broadcaster’s count continues across seasons.

What does Bölüm mean?

Bölüm means episode in Turkish. A provider listing labelled 87. Bölüm belongs to the same original broadcast as Season 4 Episode 4 in this guide.

Why can a dubbed number be different?

Subtitles translate the on-screen dialogue while retaining the original spoken audio. Dubbing replaces the voice track and may be distributed in shorter cuts. A dubbed Episode 87 should not automatically be treated as original Turkish Episode 87.

How to match a viewing page

Check the series, season and original number together. Then confirm whether the page offers Urdu subtitles, English subtitles or Urdu dubbing. Our guides show both numbers above the viewing buttons.
